content.text:
.subckt DUT VINP VINN VOUT VDD VSS IBIAS
* 10 uA reference and complementary input-pair bias tree
XNR IBIAS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=2 m=1
XNT ntail IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=20 l=2 m=1
XNBP pbias IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=2 m=1
XPR pbias pbias VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=10 l=2 m=1
XPT ptail pbias VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=40 l=2 m=1

* Rail-to-rail input pairs with separate balanced mirror loads.
* The two mirror outputs sum at x with the same differential polarity.
XNIREF nda VINN ntail VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1.5 m=1
XNIOUT x VINP ntail VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1.5 m=1
XNPLOAD nda nda VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=80 l=2 m=1
XNPLOAD2 x nda VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=2 m=1

XPIOUT x VINP ptail VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=80 l=1.5 m=1
XPIREF pda VINN ptail VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=80 l=1.5 m=1
XNLOAD pda pda VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=40 l=2 m=1
XNLOAD2 x pda VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=40 l=2 m=1

* Independent x common-mode setting load
RXL VDD x 470000
XNLX x IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.4 l=2 m=1

* Weak port-level DC/large-signal feed-forward for unity tracking
RFF VINP VOUT 470000

* Class-A inverting output stage, nominally 100 uA
XPO VOUT pbias VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=25 l=2 m=1
XNO VOUT x VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=2 m=1

* Miller compensation with a series zero-setting resistor
RCZ x ncomp 20000
CCZ ncomp VOUT 3.3e-12
.ends DUT
